description: Lalitha Jewellery Pvt Ltd v. The Deputy Director of Customs and Another Lalitha Jewellery Pvt Ltd v. The Deputy Director of Customs and Another View More before Hon. A.W. Abdus Salam, J.
parties: Lalitha Jewellery Pvt Ltd v. The Deputy Director of Customs and Another Lalitha Jewellery Pvt Ltd v. The Deputy Director of Customs and Another View More
keywords: The plaintiff company sought damages following a Customs inquiry that resulted in the forfeiture of five gold plates and the imposition of a penalty. The District Court found that the gold had been unlawfully imported and purchased by the plaintiff, and that the penalty was properly imposed. Held - found no basis to interfere with the trial judge’s evaluation of the evidence; Application dismissed without costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
